youtube.baslik: How can one subtraction tell you masking is needed? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: For air conduction, subtract the bone-conduction threshold of the non-test ear (NTE) from the threshold of the test ear (TE). If the difference reaches interaural attenuation (IA), 40 dB for supra-aural and about 55 dB for insert earphones, masking is needed.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Can one subtraction tell you masking is needed?
bilgiler: Subtract the NTE bone threshold from the TE air threshold.
If it reaches IA, mask: 40 dB supra-aural, about 55 dB insert.
Compare with the bone conduction of the other ear, not its air conduction.

sahneler.alt: TE air minus NTE bone: mask _if it reaches IA_
cumleler: We start with the air-conduction threshold of the test ear.
From it, we subtract the bone threshold of the other ear.
If the difference equals or exceeds interaural attenuation, masking is needed.
This is forty decibels for supra-aural, fifty five for insert earphones.
We compare with the other ear's bone conduction, not its air.
